_comment: The Lamplighter's lamp oil (content-zone-2-woodland.md §3.8): fetch a flask from Gnome 1 in Dionsburg, who hands it over to a player who delivered the stolen shipment or is level 7, and bring it to the Lamplighter, whose turn-in teaches Lamp. Two ways in: the Lamplighter offers it at fetch, the gnome after the shipment at bring. Priced at L7 by the L9 half-level rule.
